description: This file contains build definitions and macros for building boot scripts and images for the i.MX8M platform, including specific device configurations such as Gateworks Venice. It defines macros for creating boot scripts, ext4 images, and device-specific parameters.

methods.name: Build/boot-scr
methods.description: Defines the process to create a boot script image using mkimage.

methods.name: Build/boot-img-ext4
methods.description: Defines the process to create an ext4 filesystem image for boot.

methods.name: Build/sdcard-img-ext4
methods.description: Defines how to generate an ext4 sdcard image with partition signatures.

methods.name: Device/imx8m
methods.description: Specific configuration for the NXP i.MX8M device based on default settings.

methods.name: Device/gateworks_venice
methods.description: Specific device configuration for Gateworks Venice, including device-specific parameters, supported device list, and image build rules.
